The Fake Advocate

By: Sophia Phirippides | Delivery

Proposal


Show: Carte Blanche

One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...):
In this new era, dubbed the new normal, how else could we expose a charlatan advocate, but in an elaborate online sting as we reveal how she stole the identity of a longstanding member of the bar.

Unique Selling Point:
Possibly never attempted before - an elaborate online bust of an impostor masquerading as an advocate. Pauline Pretorius, AKA Johanna Petronella Jansen Van Vuuren, stole the identity of her alias, a long standing member of the bar, and has profited from this for years.

Pauline Pretorius’s maiden name, she claims, is Johanna Petronella Jansen Van Vuuren, co-incidentally the same as Advocate Johanna Petronella Jansen Van Vuuren. Even more remarkable is that both women are in possession of certificates, awarded on the same day in August 2013, qualifying them to be admitted and authorised “to practice and to be enrolled as an advocate of the High Court”.

There the similarities end, and from amongst Pauline Pretorius’s ranks suspicions led to challenges of her Right to Appear in the High Court… and her assertion that she gained a Bachelor of Law (LL.B.). The whistleblower June Kotze realized there was something fishy in the conduct of Pauline Pretorius and challenged her, leading to emails which we have - and Pretorius furnishing Kotze with her fake advocate certificate as ‘proof’ she was who she claimed she was. The real Johanna Petronella Jansen Van Vuuren was horrified that her identity has been stolen for the deception.


Summary:
The Sting:
Monday 26 Oct 2020
Location: Vermaak and Partners Attorneys, Rosebank.
Carmargue Estate Homeowners vs Sweet Water Properties: 2019/43378
Presenter will guide us through the process especially at the beginning, they’ll explain we are part of a Zoom meeting which has to do with a taxation issue and we are about to expose a fake advocate.
In the Zoom meeting will be Pauline Pretorius. She doesn’t know that Carte Blanche are on the line.
The sting will come when Pretorius presents to the judge. The plan is that she will be challenged by the Attorney, who is in on the sting, and then the real Johanna will come on to the screen and also challenge her… at which point we are not sure how this will transpire.
The real Johanna will have her real advocate certificate on hand and we can show Pretorius that her certificate has the same case number on it.
Then what we’ll do, depending on what transpires, we will try to interrupt the proceedings and ask Pauline if she’d like to respond to the allegations directly to Carte Blanche or she could respond there and then or if she would give us an interview.

A central interview is June Kotze, the original whistleblower who picked up the fact that this wasn’t a proper taxation attorney she was dealing with, that there’s something wrong here (as did her husband). She will explain why she started to question the validity of this person. Then she did her checks.
Another central interview is Judge President Dunstan Mlambo who can talk about the fact that you cannot appear in court if you don’t have the rights granted by an appearance certificate – and he will go into ramifications and accountability.

We also have recordings as evidence of Pretorius’s deception, including a Legal Practice Council phone call that says she is not registered, and UNISA stating she has not finished her studies towards a Bachelor of Law degree (which she purports to have).

Further information:
The real Johanna Petronella van Jansen Vuuren is a 61-year-old advocate from Brits. She works for Solidarity and her sphere of expertise lies in worker’s compensation law. She has previously appeared on Carte Blanche as an expert in this sphere. She is known by family, friends and colleagues as ‘Hanlie van Vuuren’ and works for Solidarity as its Head of Occupational Health and Safety.

A Bachelor of Laws degree is a prerequisite to admission as a legal practitioner. On 8 August 2013, already in her mid-50’s, Hanlie was admitted as an advocate in the Pretoria High Court as an advocate.

Hanlie is an impressive lady who in November 2013, three months after being admitted as an advocate, submitted her 375-page dissertation for her Master of Laws degree. It is titled “A Legal Comparison between South African, Canadian and Australian Workmen’s Compensation Law.” She holds both an LL.B and an LL.M.

Unknown to Hanlie until 19 October 2020, she had a much younger namesake. She was horrified to learn of Pauline Pretorius, AKA Johanna Petronella Jansen Van Vuuren.

Pauline Pretorius is a Gauteng based legal cost consultant, dealing mainly with the last part of the litigation chain called the Taxation of a Bill of Costs. This is the court process where the winner of a law suit is awarded costs, and the loser is obliged to pay a substantial portion of the costs incurred by the winner. The cost consultant advises attorneys in quantifying these costs.

Crucially in this story, a legal costs consultant is hired by the attorney and is only allowed to appear before a Registrar of the Court, called a Taxing Master, if the instructing attorney is present or if the cost consultant herself has been granted a Right of Appearance in the High Court. This is evidenced, in the case of an advocate, by a Certificate of Enrolment as an Advocate, or as an attorney, by a Certificate of Right of Appearance in the High Court. And to gain this prestigious right Pauline Pretorius went the illegal route, apparently forging a Certificate of Enrolment as an Advocate in the name of Johanna Petronella Jansen Van Vuuren – and taking on that name as her maiden name. We have images of both Johanna’s certificates, which almost match apart from a couple of telltale discrepancies – the imposter’s certificate includes her ID number which does not normally appear on such documents, and she used the new name for the issuing authority “In the High Court of South Africa (Gauteng Division, Pretoria)” which was not in use on 8 August 2013, the date of issue – the correct name on that date being at the head of the real Johanna’s certificate (North Gauteng High Court, Pretoria (Republic of South Africa).

Press Release:


Court cases can cost millions in damages, but what happens if the cost consultant doing the calculations is an imposter posing as an advocate of the High Court? n a special online sting we catch an imposter who's taken the legal profession for a ride.

Script:


LINK: Fakes and scamsters have been the lifeblood of Carte Blanche for more than 30 years. But now in the times of COVID, We are going online, not to bust a common criminal, but someone who is posing as an advocate of the High Court.

Title: - THE IMPOSTER
VO: Pauline Pretorius is the alleged imposter // beat…// using this certificate of one Advocate Johanna Petronella Jansen Van Vuuren and appearing before the courts as a legal cost consultant for years //beat..// but is this certificate even real?

LINK: Just three minutes before we go live. So let's meet the team.

VO: Enter the actual Advocate Johanna Petronella Jansen Van Vuuren, known as Hanlie, head of Occupational Health and Safety at Solidarity - a trade union.

Hanlie: I've studied law to help people. I'm working with specifically occupational injuries and diseases. And then to be confronted by someone who takes that ideal and uses it for their own purposes is for me a devastating thought

VO: Legal Cost consultant June Kotze, and attorney HennieKotze - the couple who discovered the alleged fraud

June: Her wording in her correspondence and her communication didn't seem to indicate that she had any real understanding of some basic principles of law, which of course raised my suspicions

VO: And Mike Marshall the instructing attorney in this liquidation matter - Costs Proceedings which are the final phase of litigation, when costs are awarded. //
With the permission of the Judge President, he is linking us to the Virtual hearing presented by Pauline Pretorius. Unaware she is about to be caught in the act, she displays her Right of Appearance Certificate.
Title - The Sting

(inaudible mumbling from Pauline until 05:30).
Woman on Zoom call 05:36: I see the name is Johana Petronella. Sorry can I just see that again.
Title: Voice of cost consultant for Mr Marshall
Pauline: Ja. Janse van Vuren. That is my name, my maiden name and my surname. It has been amended for personal purposes. Mr Taxing Master I can even give you my ID number, you'll see that it corresponds with the ID number.

VO: But let's pause for a moment - there's more to come. How did we know what Pauline is displaying is a fake certificate?
Title - The evidence

June: In order to be a cost consultant,you do not necessarily have to be an admitted attorney. But in order to present the taxation to a Taxing Master, you do need to have that right ofappearance because it is a court appearance

LINK: A legal cost consultant is pivotal to a case because they can either maximise the costs for the winners or minimise them for the losers; and we can be talking about millions.

VO: They are the persons responsible for quantifying the costs in the final stage of a court case, like June Kotze, but she does not have the right of appearance in court - June presents with her attorney husband, Hennie Kotze, who originally challenged Pauline's right of appearance.

June: He actually said, but you obviously clearly do not understand the legal process. And in fact, do you have right to the appearance? She didn't even think about it twice. Actually her answer was an emphatic "No". She said “I do not have right of appearance”

VO: But Straight after the court session Pauline Pretorius did an about turn.

June: I got a WhatsApp from Pauline saying she actually has a full LLB and a master's degree, she is an admitted advocate of the High Court.

VO: So June challenged Pauline to send her credentials. Pretorius obliged.

June: the first thing that struck me was the name. It was Johanna Petronella JANSE van Vuuren. How do you get fromPauline Pretorius to these names?

VO: Pauline isn't phased when the same question comes up in the hearing.

Mike Marshall’s Cost Consultant: Your ID says your name is Pauline Pretorious. The name on your certificate is Johana Petronella Janse van Vuren. That is very far apart.
Title: Voice of Cost Consultant for Mike Marshall
VO: At this point Pauline is joined by Peet du Plessis from JP du Plessis Attorneys.
Peet: Good morning Mr Taxing master. My name is Peet du Plessis. I can confirm the right of appearance as well as the identity number.

VO: It appears Peet du Plessis isn’t aware of any fraud at this point.
On the other hand June Kotze discovered another deception after she had tracked down the "real Johanna", and on her request, she asked Pauline for her Legal Practice Council number, which is supposed to be unique to every practitioner.

Hanlie: So she also via email provided the registration number that I have with the LPC as her registration number with the LPC.

VO: As a member of the Legal Practice Council, Anthony Millar has been mandated to look into this case, and highlights the discrepancies between the two certificates.

Derek: Now we've got two advocates, each with their own certificate. I think you've seen them. What are your reflections?
Anthony: The first one is for someone called JohannaPetronella Jansen van Vuuren. And that certificate relates to an admission the eighth of August 2013 and there's a particular case number. This certificate complies with what one normally sees in circumstances where it's a genuine admission****JOHANNA**.
The second certificate is somewhat problematical. The first is that the heading on the certificate is incorrect. In 2014, the court in Gauteng was renamed and so the description of the courts on court orders changed.***PAULINE***

LINK: This court was renamed the High Court of South Africa Gauteng division Pretoria on the 28th of February 2014. The slight problem with Pauline's certificate is that she used the new name six months before it was officially gazetted.

Anthony: So whoever issued this certificate, if it was issued in 2013, would have been clairvoyant, or it wasn't issued in 2013

VO: The fake certificate has an ID number which is not usual and also shows the fake Jansen Van Vuuren as 23 years younger than the real one. There is a spelling error on Jansen (a missing ‘n’), And the signatures of the registrar differ even though the case numbers match.


Anthony: The LPC records have been checked, there is no record whatsoever in South Africa of any legal Practitioner with the name Johanna Petronella Janse van Vuren. There is no record in South Africa of any legal practitioner bearing the identity number. There's also no record whatsoever of any legal practitioner in the country by the name of Pauline Pretorius.
Derek: So it appears to be a case of forgery.
Anthony: Yes, correct.

VO: But there is even more to Pauline’s deception, so it's time to ask her in person.
Title: The confrontation

Sound up Derek: Ok Bring me up...
Derek: Hi Pauline. I'm Derek Watts from Carte Blanche. How are you doing?
Pauline: Good and yourself?
Derek: I just want to ask you a few questions if you don't mind. Are you Pauline Pretorius?
Pauline: Yes.Derek: Who is Johanna Petronella Janse van Vuuren?
Pauline: Jansen van Vuuren. That is myself.
Derek: How does this name relate to you as Pauline Pretorius?
Pauline: Can you kindly confirm what is the reason for your inquiry?
Derek: Well, we have an amazing coincidence. Johanna Petronella Jansen van Vuuren who is sitting next to me right here was enrolled as an advocate of the high court on the same day as you.
Pauline: Well sir I don't even know who that is.
Derek: Don't you think that's unbelievable? But apart from that Pauline, apart from that one in a trillion chance, you have the same case number. (silence).
Pauline: Sir how do you want me to respond to that if that is my case number on my documents?
VO: She's sticking to her guns on the documents, so let's introduce a new piece of evidence.
Title: The Double Whammy.
Derek: You sent a tweet in 2014 to say that you were just starting your law degree with Unisa.
Pauline:That was for a master's degree
Derek: Somehow you managed to get enrolled as an advocate of the High Court before you started your law degree?
Pauline: No. There's no way that could happen because it was my master's degree in respect to family law.
Derek: No, No, that's not as we know it Pauline. Unisa states that you've not even completed your studies towards a bachelor of law degree. (silence). you've only completed 14 out of 40 modules.
Derek: Pauline, I put it to you that you are deliberately and fraudulently using ID theft to deceive the courts and your clients as to your validity to appear in a court of law.
Pauline: I absolutely deny that. I'm sorry.
Derek: Pauline, I think we have to sort this out in a face to face interview, then could we set up a meeting for Wednesday?
Pauline: Yes. Subject to being advised by an attorney.
Derek: Why would you need to be advised if you're telling us the truth?
Pauline: Because you have just made very, very serious allegations.

VO: Mike Marshall informs the taxing master that a case has been opened with the Police and a formal complaint laid with the LPC by Hanlie Jansen Van Vuuren.

Hanlie: (showing her certificate). May I show my certificate Mr Taxing master. It's framed
Taxing master: These are very serious allegations that were presented before me.

Title: Voice of Taxing Master Mr Maqala

VO: The taxing master ordered all documentation to be uploaded and for Pauline who hosted the meeting to supply the recording for the record. The taxation was postponed.

Derek: Hanlie, I saw how shocked you were during that discussion.
Hanlie: I'm still feeling jittery, I'm totally shocked.
Derek: Do you think she'll see us on Wednesday?
Michael: I think it's very unlikely.

Visual music transition
Title: The duck and dive.
Derek: We're just going to call Pauline Pretorius to confirm that appointment for Wednesday, which she agreed to. (goes to voicemail). Okay, we'll try again later. Should we give it just a minute or two.
quick montage of Derek getting no response
Derek: (goes to voicemail). Well, we hope to have better luck later.
Derek: Pauline, Derek Watts from Carte Blanche again, We look forward to seeing you on Wednesday,


VO: We called Mr Hennie du Plessis to try and track Pauline Pretorius down, he had also defended Pauline's credentials, originally in an email to June Kotze, but has subsequently checked that she is not a member of the LPC.

Hennie: I made about 16 calls yesterday to her phone. her phone was off. And around about 10 o'clock last night she phoned me and confirmed that she was in consultation with her legal representatives and she's been advised not to say anything to anyone at this stage

VO: A written response to Carte Blanche from Mr Hennie du Plessis, stated that they have "terminated all mandates given to Pauline Pretorius as an independent cost consultant".

VO: To date, we have been told that Pauline has not uploaded her credentials or the recording to the Taxing Master Mr Maqala as agreed. But Hanlie is determined to see justice served.

Hanlie: I would like a severe penalty. But the legal profession has to be protected and my honour and dignity needs to be protected.

Script: LINK: Fakes and scamsters have been the lifeblood of Carte Blanche for more than 30 years. But now in the times of COVID, We are going online, not to bust a common criminal, but someone who is posing as an advocate of the High Court. Title: - THE IMPOSTER VO: Pauline Pretorius is the alleged imposter // beat…// using this certificate of one Advocate Johanna Petronella Jansen Van Vuuren and appearing before the courts as a legal cost consultant for years //beat..// but is this certificate even real? LINK: Just three minutes before we go live. So let's meet the team. VO: Enter the actual Advocate Johanna Petronella Jansen Van Vuuren, known as Hanlie, head of Occupational Health and Safety at Solidarity - a trade union. Hanlie: I've studied law to help people. I'm working with specifically occupational injuries and diseases. And then to be confronted by someone who takes that ideal and uses it for their own purposes is for me a devastating thought VO: Legal Cost consultant June Kotze, and attorney HennieKotze - the couple who discovered the alleged fraud June: Her wording in her correspondence and her communication didn't seem to indicate that she had any real understanding of some basic principles of law, which of course raised my suspicions VO: And Mike Marshall the instructing attorney in this liquidation matter - Costs Proceedings which are the final phase of litigation, when costs are awarded. // With the permission of the Judge President, he is linking us to the Virtual hearing presented by Pauline Pretorius. Unaware she is about to be caught in the act, she displays her Right of Appearance Certificate. Title - The Sting (inaudible mumbling from Pauline until 05:30). Woman on Zoom call 05:36: I see the name is Johana Petronella. Sorry can I just see that again. Title: Voice of cost consultant for Mr Marshall Pauline: Ja. Janse van Vuren. That is my name, my maiden name and my surname. It has been amended for personal purposes. Mr Taxing Master I can even give you my ID number, you'll see that it corresponds with the ID number. VO: But let's pause for a moment - there's more to come. How did we know what Pauline is displaying is a fake certificate? Title - The evidence June: In order to be a cost consultant,you do not necessarily have to be an admitted attorney. But in order to present the taxation to a Taxing Master, you do need to have that right ofappearance because it is a court appearance LINK: A legal cost consultant is pivotal to a case because they can either maximise the costs for the winners or minimise them for the losers; and we can be talking about millions. VO: They are the persons responsible for quantifying the costs in the final stage of a court case, like June Kotze, but she does not have the right of appearance in court - June presents with her attorney husband, Hennie Kotze, who originally challenged Pauline's right of appearance. June: He actually said, but you obviously clearly do not understand the legal process. And in fact, do you have right to the appearance? She didn't even think about it twice. Actually her answer was an emphatic "No". She said “I do not have right of appearance” VO: But Straight after the court session Pauline Pretorius did an about turn. June: I got a WhatsApp from Pauline saying she actually has a full LLB and a master's degree, she is an admitted advocate of the High Court. VO: So June challenged Pauline to send her credentials. Pretorius obliged. June: the first thing that struck me was the name. It was Johanna Petronella JANSE van Vuuren. How do you get fromPauline Pretorius to these names? VO: Pauline isn't phased when the same question comes up in the hearing. Mike Marshall’s Cost Consultant: Your ID says your name is Pauline Pretorious. The name on your certificate is Johana Petronella Janse van Vuren. That is very far apart. Title: Voice of Cost Consultant for Mike Marshall VO: At this point Pauline is joined by Peet du Plessis from JP du Plessis Attorneys. Peet: Good morning Mr Taxing master. My name is Peet du Plessis. I can confirm the right of appearance as well as the identity number. VO: It appears Peet du Plessis isn’t aware of any fraud at this point. On the other hand June Kotze discovered another deception after she had tracked down the "real Johanna", and on her request, she asked Pauline for her Legal Practice Council number, which is supposed to be unique to every practitioner. Hanlie: So she also via email provided the registration number that I have with the LPC as her registration number with the LPC. VO: As a member of the Legal Practice Council, Anthony Millar has been mandated to look into this case, and highlights the discrepancies between the two certificates. Derek: Now we've got two advocates, each with their own certificate. I think you've seen them. What are your reflections? Anthony: The first one is for someone called JohannaPetronella Jansen van Vuuren. And that certificate relates to an admission the eighth of August 2013 and there's a particular case number. This certificate complies with what one normally sees in circumstances where it's a genuine admission****JOHANNA**. The second certificate is somewhat problematical. The first is that the heading on the certificate is incorrect. In 2014, the court in Gauteng was renamed and so the description of the courts on court orders changed.***PAULINE*** LINK: This court was renamed the High Court of South Africa Gauteng division Pretoria on the 28th of February 2014. The slight problem with Pauline's certificate is that she used the new name six months before it was officially gazetted. Anthony: So whoever issued this certificate, if it was issued in 2013, would have been clairvoyant, or it wasn't issued in 2013 VO: The fake certificate has an ID number which is not usual and also shows the fake Jansen Van Vuuren as 23 years younger than the real one. There is a spelling error on Jansen (a missing ‘n’), And the signatures of the registrar differ even though the case numbers match. Anthony: The LPC records have been checked, there is no record whatsoever in South Africa of any legal Practitioner with the name Johanna Petronella Janse van Vuren. There is no record in South Africa of any legal practitioner bearing the identity number. There's also no record whatsoever of any legal practitioner in the country by the name of Pauline Pretorius. Derek: So it appears to be a case of forgery. Anthony: Yes, correct. VO: But there is even more to Pauline’s deception, so it's time to ask her in person. Title: The confrontation Sound up Derek: Ok Bring me up... Derek: Hi Pauline. I'm Derek Watts from Carte Blanche. How are you doing? Pauline: Good and yourself? Derek: I just want to ask you a few questions if you don't mind. Are you Pauline Pretorius? Pauline: Yes.Derek: Who is Johanna Petronella Janse van Vuuren? Pauline: Jansen van Vuuren. That is myself. Derek: How does this name relate to you as Pauline Pretorius? Pauline: Can you kindly confirm what is the reason for your inquiry? Derek: Well, we have an amazing coincidence. Johanna Petronella Jansen van Vuuren who is sitting next to me right here was enrolled as an advocate of the high court on the same day as you. Pauline: Well sir I don't even know who that is. Derek: Don't you think that's unbelievable? But apart from that Pauline, apart from that one in a trillion chance, you have the same case number. (silence). Pauline: Sir how do you want me to respond to that if that is my case number on my documents? VO: She's sticking to her guns on the documents, so let's introduce a new piece of evidence. Title: The Double Whammy. Derek: You sent a tweet in 2014 to say that you were just starting your law degree with Unisa. Pauline:That was for a master's degree Derek: Somehow you managed to get enrolled as an advocate of the High Court before you started your law degree? Pauline: No. There's no way that could happen because it was my master's degree in respect to family law. Derek: No, No, that's not as we know it Pauline. Unisa states that you've not even completed your studies towards a bachelor of law degree. (silence). you've only completed 14 out of 40 modules. Derek: Pauline, I put it to you that you are deliberately and fraudulently using ID theft to deceive the courts and your clients as to your validity to appear in a court of law. Pauline: I absolutely deny that. I'm sorry. Derek: Pauline, I think we have to sort this out in a face to face interview, then could we set up a meeting for Wednesday? Pauline: Yes. Subject to being advised by an attorney. Derek: Why would you need to be advised if you're telling us the truth? Pauline: Because you have just made very, very serious allegations. VO: Mike Marshall informs the taxing master that a case has been opened with the Police and a formal complaint laid with the LPC by Hanlie Jansen Van Vuuren. Hanlie: (showing her certificate). May I show my certificate Mr Taxing master. It's framed Taxing master: These are very serious allegations that were presented before me. Title: Voice of Taxing Master Mr Maqala VO: The taxing master ordered all documentation to be uploaded and for Pauline who hosted the meeting to supply the recording for the record. The taxation was postponed. Derek: Hanlie, I saw how shocked you were during that discussion. Hanlie: I'm still feeling jittery, I'm totally shocked. Derek: Do you think she'll see us on Wednesday? Michael: I think it's very unlikely. Visual music transition Title: The duck and dive. Derek: We're just going to call Pauline Pretorius to confirm that appointment for Wednesday, which she agreed to. (goes to voicemail). Okay, we'll try again later. Should we give it just a minute or two. quick montage of Derek getting no response Derek: (goes to voicemail). Well, we hope to have better luck later. Derek: Pauline, Derek Watts from Carte Blanche again, We look forward to seeing you on Wednesday, VO: We called Mr Hennie du Plessis to try and track Pauline Pretorius down, he had also defended Pauline's credentials, originally in an email to June Kotze, but has subsequently checked that she is not a member of the LPC. Hennie: I made about 16 calls yesterday to her phone. her phone was off. And around about 10 o'clock last night she phoned me and confirmed that she was in consultation with her legal representatives and she's been advised not to say anything to anyone at this stage VO: A written response to Carte Blanche from Mr Hennie du Plessis, stated that they have "terminated all mandates given to Pauline Pretorius as an independent cost consultant". VO: To date, we have been told that Pauline has not uploaded her credentials or the recording to the Taxing Master Mr Maqala as agreed. But Hanlie is determined to see justice served. Hanlie: I would like a severe penalty. But the legal profession has to be protected and my honour and dignity needs to be protected.

metadata.One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...): In this new era, dubbed the new normal, how else could we expose a charlatan advocate, but in an elaborate online sting as we reveal how she stole the identity of a longstanding member of the bar.
metadata.Unique Selling Point: Possibly never attempted before - an elaborate online bust of an impostor masquerading as an advocate. Pauline Pretorius, AKA Johanna Petronella Jansen Van Vuuren, stole the identity of her alias, a long standing member of the bar, and has profited from this for years. Pauline Pretorius’s maiden name, she claims, is Johanna Petronella Jansen Van Vuuren, co-incidentally the same as Advocate Johanna Petronella Jansen Van Vuuren. Even more remarkable is that both women are in possession of certificates, awarded on the same day in August 2013, qualifying them to be admitted and authorised “to practice and to be enrolled as an advocate of the High Court”. There the similarities end, and from amongst Pauline Pretorius’s ranks suspicions led to challenges of her Right to Appear in the High Court… and her assertion that she gained a Bachelor of Law (LL.B.). The whistleblower June Kotze realized there was something fishy in the conduct of Pauline Pretorius and challenged her, leading to emails which we have - and Pretorius furnishing Kotze with her fake advocate certificate as ‘proof’ she was who she claimed she was. The real Johanna Petronella Jansen Van Vuuren was horrified that her identity has been stolen for the deception.
metadata.Summary: The Sting: Monday 26 Oct 2020 Location: Vermaak and Partners Attorneys, Rosebank. Carmargue Estate Homeowners vs Sweet Water Properties: 2019/43378 Presenter will guide us through the process especially at the beginning, they’ll explain we are part of a Zoom meeting which has to do with a taxation issue and we are about to expose a fake advocate. In the Zoom meeting will be Pauline Pretorius. She doesn’t know that Carte Blanche are on the line. The sting will come when Pretorius presents to the judge. The plan is that she will be challenged by the Attorney, who is in on the sting, and then the real Johanna will come on to the screen and also challenge her… at which point we are not sure how this will transpire. The real Johanna will have her real advocate certificate on hand and we can show Pretorius that her certificate has the same case number on it. Then what we’ll do, depending on what transpires, we will try to interrupt the proceedings and ask Pauline if she’d like to respond to the allegations directly to Carte Blanche or she could respond there and then or if she would give us an interview. A central interview is June Kotze, the original whistleblower who picked up the fact that this wasn’t a proper taxation attorney she was dealing with, that there’s something wrong here (as did her husband). She will explain why she started to question the validity of this person. Then she did her checks. Another central interview is Judge President Dunstan Mlambo who can talk about the fact that you cannot appear in court if you don’t have the rights granted by an appearance certificate – and he will go into ramifications and accountability. We also have recordings as evidence of Pretorius’s deception, including a Legal Practice Council phone call that says she is not registered, and UNISA stating she has not finished her studies towards a Bachelor of Law degree (which she purports to have).
metadata.Further information: The real Johanna Petronella van Jansen Vuuren is a 61-year-old advocate from Brits. She works for Solidarity and her sphere of expertise lies in worker’s compensation law. She has previously appeared on Carte Blanche as an expert in this sphere. She is known by family, friends and colleagues as ‘Hanlie van Vuuren’ and works for Solidarity as its Head of Occupational Health and Safety. A Bachelor of Laws degree is a prerequisite to admission as a legal practitioner. On 8 August 2013, already in her mid-50’s, Hanlie was admitted as an advocate in the Pretoria High Court as an advocate. Hanlie is an impressive lady who in November 2013, three months after being admitted as an advocate, submitted her 375-page dissertation for her Master of Laws degree. It is titled “A Legal Comparison between South African, Canadian and Australian Workmen’s Compensation Law.” She holds both an LL.B and an LL.M. Unknown to Hanlie until 19 October 2020, she had a much younger namesake. She was horrified to learn of Pauline Pretorius, AKA Johanna Petronella Jansen Van Vuuren. Pauline Pretorius is a Gauteng based legal cost consultant, dealing mainly with the last part of the litigation chain called the Taxation of a Bill of Costs. This is the court process where the winner of a law suit is awarded costs, and the loser is obliged to pay a substantial portion of the costs incurred by the winner. The cost consultant advises attorneys in quantifying these costs. Crucially in this story, a legal costs consultant is hired by the attorney and is only allowed to appear before a Registrar of the Court, called a Taxing Master, if the instructing attorney is present or if the cost consultant herself has been granted a Right of Appearance in the High Court. This is evidenced, in the case of an advocate, by a Certificate of Enrolment as an Advocate, or as an attorney, by a Certificate of Right of Appearance in the High Court. And to gain this prestigious right Pauline Pretorius went the illegal route, apparently forging a Certificate of Enrolment as an Advocate in the name of Johanna Petronella Jansen Van Vuuren – and taking on that name as her maiden name. We have images of both Johanna’s certificates, which almost match apart from a couple of telltale discrepancies – the imposter’s certificate includes her ID number which does not normally appear on such documents, and she used the new name for the issuing authority “In the High Court of South Africa (Gauteng Division, Pretoria)” which was not in use on 8 August 2013, the date of issue – the correct name on that date being at the head of the real Johanna’s certificate (North Gauteng High Court, Pretoria (Republic of South Africa).
